entry_state: About five metres up at the far end of the grass pitch, seen from just behind, the white airplane glides to the right over the crowded black chair blocks in front of the stage, toward the row of white booth tents on the right long side of the red track.
beats: Continuing the reference video without any cut, at the same low height, the airplane finishes its slow curve around the far end and flies back along the RIGHT long side of the red track over the row of white booth tents full of students, toward the school, gradually lowering to just above head height. The camera stays about two metres behind it.
At the near end it curves gently left over the road to the busy food-truck lot: students queuing at the six colourful trucks and eating at the yellow parasol tables, seen from above and behind.
It curves right and glides along the road and over the lawn with red, green and orange bean bags where groups of students lounge, chat and laugh.
It turns smoothly toward the green inflatable air arch at the track gate, where students pose for photos, and flies straight through the middle of the arch; the camera passes through right behind it.
Inside the track it glides low across the grass pitch, past the sound booth, just above the heads of the many students sitting together in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.

Only now does it rise: the airplane climbs smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and keeps climbing straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with sky and sunlight and glows to pure white.
exit_state: The frame is entirely bright white light.
audio: diegetic only: lively festival ambience (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle, footsteps), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
extra_negatives: no high aerial drone view before the stage
no change of the festival layout
no air arch on the grass

change_request.reason: Part 1 trimmed at 18.17s (hidden cut); part 2 now also finishes the lap (right side back to the school) before F4-F8, so 26s.
